handlers/chat/chat-prompt.ts: Assembles a complete turn prompt; its excerpts are prompt context rather than a document continuation.
handlers/chat/send-message.ts: Reads complete attachments for a turn; phases describe durable execution rather than document windows.
handlers/files/get.ts: Streams a complete binary download; phase identifies a stamp failure rather than a document continuation.
lib/document-processing-queue.ts: Processes whole input files; its cursor pages repair jobs rather than the contents of a document.
